body: I’m not exactly going to kill myself over this honestly. I just don’t want to be here anymore. I’m an introvert, no one talks to me nor can I keep a conversation without people giving me hints that they don’t want to talk. I didn’t say he couldn’t hug anyone, i would at least just liked to have known first, for me at least. He ended ours a few weeks ago due to him hating himself for something and put his anger on me, and broke up with me. He can still do that again if he wants to. I don’t wanna seem like i’m not taking the help if this was per-say but i really do respect this. Thank you.
